# Alexandros Shomper — Product Designer & Growth Advisor

> Product Designer with 15+ years across B2B SaaS, PLG, and complex workflow design.
> Based in Munich. Available for freelance contracts (€90/hr) and full-time PM/design roles.

## About
Alexandros Shomper is a remote-first, outcome-oriented product lead and designer with
experience ranging from early-stage startups to corporate digital transformation. Background
in advertising, marketing, and self-taught development.

## Case Studies
- [Knauf Material Calculator](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/knauf-material-calculator):
  B2B SaaS for construction professionals. Activation +25%, Retention +30%, NPS +15.
  12 markets, 18 months, 0→1→n.
- [Knauf Order Overview](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/knauf-order-overview):
  Unified order tracking platform. -20% service calls, +30% activation, 2h/week saved per dealer.
- [Occhio Website & eCommerce](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/portfolio/occhio):
  Digital transformation of premium lighting brand. First-ever online revenue stream.
- [Asana Onboarding Case Study](https://www.alexandrosshomper.de/case-studies/asana):
  Redesign analysis of Asana's onboarding flow.
